name: Married To A Stranger
overview: After escaping an abusive relationship, Lily Henderson impulsively kisses a stranger, Tristan Hawthorne, to convince her possessive ex-boyfriend, Mathew Gregor, that she has moved on. Following a one-night encounter, Lily is shocked to discover that Mathew is now the CEO of the company where she is interviewing for her dream job. Though he hires her, his intentions are far from innocent. Meanwhile, Tristan reappears with an unusual proposal: pretend to be his fiancée in exchange for money and a taste of luxury. As Lily struggles to navigate her complicated past, a controlling ex, and a fake engagement, she finds herself caught in a web of secrets, misunderstandings, and unexpected romance.
